purpose: Classify missing inputs from the first complete GW1 baseline materialisation without filling any missing player rate with zero or an invented prior.

categories.rule: OWN_TEAM_PROMOTED_PRIOR is present on the baseline gap row
categories.required_prior_source: Reviewed lower-division player history plus an explicit league-translation policy; team-strength priors alone are not player-rate priors.

categories.rule: Not a promoted-team player and FPL team_join_date is on or after 2026-06-01
categories.required_prior_source: Previous-league player history with an explicit competition translation; do not infer quality from transfer status or price alone.

categories.rule: Not a promoted-team player and FPL team_join_date is before 2026-06-01
categories.required_prior_source: Most recent senior competition or loan history with source and recency recorded; retain a gap if no suitable evidence exists.

audit_notes: The three player-rate categories are mutually exclusive and sum to 128.
The 2026-06-01 date is an audit partition for summer arrivals, not a modelling feature or evidence of playing strength.
Missing appearance and missing player rates are orthogonal: 17 players have both, two have only missing appearance, and 111 have only missing player rates.
The next safe action is coverage research and a reviewed prior import boundary, not automatic position-average imputation.
The local DuckDB file and generated projections remain gitignored.
